mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced economic demand and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST drops by more than 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side dynamics, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5%, the combination signals a tight labor market with high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the past month, combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals significant labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS drops by more than 100k and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 drops by more than 0.5% QoQ.
